name: YukkiMusic
description: A high-performance C++20 Telegram bot engine that streams music into group voice chats with seamless playback and control.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org.

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from my.telegram.org.

STRING_SESSION.description: A Pyrogram string session for the assistant.

YUKI_API_KEY.description: API key for Yuki Music API (optional). Defaults to official public gateway key.

YUKI_API_URL.description: Base URL for the Yuki Music API engine (https://music.yukiapi.site).

OWNER_ID.description: The Telegram user ID of the bot's owner.

LOGGER_ID.description: (Optional) Telegram chat ID where logs/errors will be sent. Leave empty to disable chat logging.

DURATION_LIMIT.description: The maximum duration of a track in seconds.

LEAVE_ON_DEMOTED.description: Leave the group when the bot is demoted. Set to true to enable.

QUEUE_LIMIT.description: The maximum number of tracks allowed in the queue.

DISABLE_COLOUR.description: Disable coloured inline button styles in Telegram when set to true.

START_IMAGES.description: Optional list of /start image URLs separated by spaces, commas, or semicolons. A random image is used each time.

EFFECT_IDS.description: List of Telegram message effect IDs separated by spaces, commas, or semicolons. A random effect is applied when the /start command is used. If unsure, try 5104841245755180586.

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: The URL of your support chat.

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: The URL of your support channel.

COOKIES_LINK.description: A space-separated list of batbin.me URLs for cookies.

SET_CMDS.description: Set to 'true' to have the bot set its commands on startup.

MAX_AUTH_USERS.description: The maximum number of authorized users per chat.
